author: Psiphen
quote: It’s actually insane just how unfun this game is. Realism does not create a good game. There is a reason the bought and paid for reviews never mention the gameplay: because it’s bad. Not to mention all of the bugs and glitches, and still running at 30fps

author: Psiphen
quote: This game is amazing. It’s funny, sad, emotional, everything. It is my favorite game of all time. The gameplay loop is phenomenal. Please go play this game
